reason: A proposes a physically credible, directly testable consolidation intervention: pressure-assisted SPS can densify ZrB2 at lower temperature and reduce connected porosity, with matched specimens and long-duration bath exposure providing a clear falsification route. B conflates low-temperature synthesis of high-entropy diboride powders in the cited work with densification of monolithic single-phase ZrB2, so its evidence does not establish the claimed reduction in component porosity or improved bath durability.
